items.title: Apple reports second quarter results
items.snippet: Apple reported fiscal 2026 second-quarter revenue of $111.2 billion and said iPhone achieved a March quarter revenue record, fueled by extraordinary demand for the iPhone 17 lineup.

items.title: aapl-20260328
items.snippet: Apple’s Q2 2026 10-Q includes manufacturing purchase obligations of $44.6 billion as of March 28, 2026, and other purchase obligations of $30.4 billion.

items.title: aapl-20250927
items.snippet: Apple’s 10-K describes risks including competition, new technologies, production ramp-up issues, supplier and inventory management, and the need to meet anticipated demand in appropriate quantities and at expected costs.

items.title: aapl-20250329
items.snippet: Apple’s 10-Q says gross margins are pressured by pricing pressures, competition, demand stimulation challenges, compressed product cycles, supply shortages, tariffs, trade restrictions, and macroeconomic pressures.

items.title: Apple (AAPL) Share Price Faces More Pain as Trump’s Tariff Threat Looms - Bloomberg
items.snippet: Bloomberg reported Apple shares faced pressure after tariff threats, citing product concentration and trade-related risk concerns.
